newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt to boost share repurchases.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt to boost share repurchases.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc said Tuesday it plans to increase share repurchases by $250 million.
"We are expanding our ongoing stock buyback to share proceeds from the sale of Mallinckrodt Veterinary with our investors," said Mallinckrodt Chief Executive Officer and Chairman Ray Holman.
The company said it had completed the sale of its worldwide animal health business to drug manufacturer Schering-Plough Corp for $405 million cash.
"We presently are involved in the most aggressive share repurchase our company has undertaken in many years," Holman said.

Earlier this year the company added $250 million to its repurchase program as a result of the divestiture of the Tastemaker joint venture. Prior to that, share repurchases were expanded by $100 million when the feed ingredients business was sold in October 1995.
The buyback program includes repurchases to offset normal option and other dilution, the company said.
